AwayLine.description:
One thing that finished without the owner: a routine's latest ok Run (count: its Runs since they left), the
vault's "3 pages expired" (opens Brain's Expired view), or Orb's own "2 sessions finished" (opens Sessions) /
"1 delegation Ready" (opens the Delegated strip) / "4 old sessions archived" (opens Sessions) / "2 sessions wait
for your OK" (now, not since; opens Sessions); count: how many.
AwayLine.title: AwayLine

AwayRecapEvent.description: Home's Away recap (away.Clock): the one-shot card after 24 hours or more without the owner acting, or None.
AwayRecapEvent.title: AwayRecapEvent

AwaySeenMsg.description: The Away recap was closed, or Home left while it showed: it goes on every page.
AwaySeenMsg.title: AwaySeenMsg

BrainAppliedEvent.description:
The answer to brain_apply, before the new list: what was written (each with the verdict asked for) and what the
vault write module refused, with its reason.
BrainAppliedEvent.title: BrainAppliedEvent

BrainApplyMsg.description:
Verdicts on Brain's list, one per note (accepting a suggestion, Apply suggestions, Restore). Each goes through the
vault write module on its own: a refused note doesn't stop the others. The server answers with brain_applied, then
the list.
BrainApplyMsg.title: BrainApplyMsg

BrainExpiredEvent.description:
Brain's Expired view (home.expired_notes): pages the vault archived in the last 30 days, newest first. Read
only: Orb never writes `auto_archived`; Keep is the approve verdict. `error` when there is no notes folder.
BrainExpiredEvent.title: BrainExpiredEvent

BrainKeepMsg.description: Keep a No-topic capture as an idea: owner_read is set, only if it still reads `seen` ("").
BrainKeepMsg.title: BrainKeepMsg

BrainListEvent.description: Brain's list: the newest notes, newest first. `error` when there is no notes folder.
BrainListEvent.title: BrainListEvent

BrainNoTopicEvent.description:
Brain's No topic view (home.notopic_notes): No-topic captures, oldest first, plus the rows this page asked for
again (`files`) with their new state. `error` when there is no notes folder.
BrainNoTopicEvent.title: BrainNoTopicEvent

BrainNoTopicMsg.description:
Brain's No topic rows. `files`: rows this page acted on (kept, dropped), listed again with their state though
they no longer count.
BrainNoTopicMsg.title: BrainNoTopicMsg

BrainNoteEvent.description: One note's page: the list fields and the body under the frontmatter, as plain text.
BrainNoteEvent.title: BrainNoteEvent

BrainReadMsg.description: The owner left an open note without a verdict: owner_read is set once, if it still reads `seen` ("").
BrainReadMsg.title: BrainReadMsg

BrainVerdictMsg.description:
A verdict on the open note: approve, reject, or restore (waits again). Written only if the note's verdict still
reads `seen`; the server answers with the note and the list.
BrainVerdictMsg.title: BrainVerdictMsg

CommandItem.description: One entry of the slash menu (slash.merge): the dashboard's own first, then Claude Code's.
CommandItem.title: CommandItem

ContextUsage.description: Tokens of the last main-thread call and the model's window.
ContextUsage.title: ContextUsage

DelegateBulkMsg.description:
Bulk Delegate from Up next: tracker tasks with a known repo. The server answers with the first repo's card; the
others follow, one per repo, whatever the answer.
DelegateBulkMsg.title: DelegateBulkMsg

DelegateCardEvent.description:
Delegate's grant card (ADR 0005): the repo, the branch and what the session may do without asking. A bulk
Delegate has one card per repo: `rows` are its tasks (task/title/branch are the first), `more` the repos still to
ask about after this one.
DelegateCardEvent.title: DelegateCardEvent

DelegateMsg.description:
Delegate on a tracker task: the server answers with the grant card. `path`: the picker's repo, for a task whose
project has no mapped repo (this delegation only).
DelegateMsg.title: DelegateMsg

DelegationDiffEvent.description: Review: the delegation's own work (snapshot..branch), stat then patch, capped.
DelegationDiffEvent.title: DelegationDiffEvent

DelegationDiscardMsg.description: Discard: stop the session, drop the branch and worktree. On an applied or reverted one: dismiss the row.
DelegationDiscardMsg.title: DelegationDiscardMsg

DelegationItem.description: One row of the Delegated strip, in the order they were delegated. `line` is the stage in plain words.
DelegationItem.title: DelegationItem

DelegationOutwardMsg.description: The outward card (Needs you): Allow pushes the branch and opens its PR; Skip (allow false) keeps it local.
DelegationOutwardMsg.title: DelegationOutwardMsg

DelegationResumeMsg.description: Stopped by restart: continue the same session in the same worktree under the same grant.
DelegationResumeMsg.title: DelegationResumeMsg

DelegationRetryMsg.description: Failed or stuck: the same session gets what went wrong as its next request (a stuck turn is stopped first).
DelegationRetryMsg.title: DelegationRetryMsg

DelegationRevertMsg.description: Undo after Apply: revert the commit and reopen the task.
DelegationRevertMsg.title: DelegationRevertMsg

DelegationUpdateMsg.description: Update from <into> on a collision: merge the remote target into the branch, the same session finishes it.
DelegationUpdateMsg.title: DelegationUpdateMsg

DropDoneEvent.description:
A drop ended (every page): a job's "Saved: <title>" and the note it wrote, a session's first turn ("Saved",
"Answered"), or why it failed.
DropDoneEvent.title: DropDoneEvent

DropMsg.description: Home's drop zone: one pasted link, or one file (name + base64 bytes).
DropMsg.title: DropMsg

DropRoutedEvent.description: A drop on Home, routed and running in the background (intake.py, ADR 0009); refused: why.
DropRoutedEvent.title: DropRoutedEvent

Features.description: What this install has turned on, and how Claude Code is signed in (plan only).
Features.title: Features

HomeAwait.description: A note waiting for the owner's verdict (fact-checked with no human_verdict, or AI-curated and unreviewed).
HomeAwait.title: HomeAwait

HomeEvent.description: The home screen's notes part (home.summary): open tasks and recent notes in the vault.
HomeEvent.title: HomeEvent

HomeForgetEvent.description: Home's Don't forget pane (forget.summary): reminders, unsaved repos, open PRs; and the pinned links.
HomeForgetEvent.title: HomeForgetEvent

HomeTasksEvent.description:
Home's view of the Tasks source (tracker.home_event): the first open tasks and the count, or why the tracker
can't be read. `tasks` is None when no tracker is set up (Home counts the notes' tasks instead).
HomeTasksEvent.title: HomeTasksEvent

ItemDoneMsg.description: Archive: mark a tracker task done (done=False brings it back). The server answers with the new item_list.
ItemDoneMsg.title: ItemDoneMsg

ItemEvent.description: One item in full (items.get): chips, plain-text body, the repo it maps to (label, None = no repo), the prompt to copy.
ItemEvent.title: ItemEvent

ItemListEvent.description: One table (items.list_): its columns and rows. `group_key` is the column to group by ("repo" = the Repo column).
ItemListEvent.title: ItemListEvent

ItemStartMsg.description: Start in Orb: a new session in the item's repo (found by the server), first request = the brief.
ItemStartMsg.title: ItemStartMsg

KokoroInstall.description: How far VoiceMode's Kokoro is set up on this Mac, for the setup's Kokoro card (running is `speech.kokoro`).
KokoroInstall.title: KokoroInstall

KokoroSetupMsg.description: One click: install what's missing of VoiceMode's Kokoro, keep it on 127.0.0.1, (re)start it.
KokoroSetupMsg.title: KokoroSetupMsg

MakeTaskCardEvent.description: "Make it a task": the card to allow or deny before Orb creates a task in the tracker (ADR 0008, 0010).
MakeTaskCardEvent.title: MakeTaskCardEvent

MakeTaskDoneEvent.description: The card's outcome: created (`task`, `url`), denied (ok false, no error) or failed (`error`).
MakeTaskDoneEvent.title: MakeTaskDoneEvent

MakeTaskMsg.description:
"Make it a task" on a routine's last run, or on a No-topic capture (`capture`, its file): the server answers
with a card first.
MakeTaskMsg.title: MakeTaskMsg

MakeTaskUndoMsg.description: Delete a task this server created with "Make it a task"; any other id is refused.
MakeTaskUndoMsg.title: MakeTaskUndoMsg

MakeTaskUndoneEvent.description: Undo of a created task: deleted (and a capture's owner_read taken off again), or why not.
MakeTaskUndoneEvent.title: MakeTaskUndoneEvent

NavigateEvent.description: open_screen: the pages showing the asking session go to a destination, or one item there (set fields only).
NavigateEvent.title: NavigateEvent

NotesVerdictMsg.description:
Bulk verdict on notes: approve, reject, or restore (waits again). The page confirms with a count first; the
vault write module writes only if every note's verdict still reads as `seen`, then the server answers with the new list.
NotesVerdictMsg.title: NotesVerdictMsg

PlanDoneMsg.description: Done on a queue task ("vikunja:<id>" or "note:<file>:<line>"): written at once; undo=True reopens the tracker's task.
PlanDoneMsg.title: PlanDoneMsg

PlanEvent.description:
Home's plan. needs_you is decided by rules (docs/adr/0001): a broken setup, routines with a problem, reminders
due today or earlier, then tasks due before today; approvals sit above it on the page. The queue (next, then up_next) is the rest worth doing. A model may
only reorder both and give reasons.
PlanEvent.title: PlanEvent

PlanItem.description:
One row of Home's plan (needs.py). title is ours; reason is the rule's, or the model's while that item's facts are
unchanged (plain text, from untrusted data).
PlanItem.title: PlanItem

PlanLaterMsg.description: Later on a queue item: hidden until the next day on every page (never written to a tracker).
PlanLaterMsg.title: PlanLaterMsg

PlanLeaveMsg.description:
Leave it on a pull request idle 14+ days ("pr:<repo>#<n>"): hidden until the PR changes (its updatedAt), never
written to GitHub (ticket 850).
PlanLeaveMsg.title: PlanLeaveMsg

PlanStartMsg.description: Home started a queue item (by its plan key): it leaves the queue for today, the next one moves up.
PlanStartMsg.title: PlanStartMsg

RevokeGrantMsg.description: Drop a delegation's grant (ADR 0005): every later tool call of that session raises a card again.
RevokeGrantMsg.title: RevokeGrantMsg

RoutineItem.description: One row of the Routines panel (routines.item).
RoutineItem.title: RoutineItem

RoutineRepair.description: The routine's open Repair task (GLOSSARY: Repair task), as the last re-read in the tracker found it.
RoutineRepair.title: RoutineRepair

RoutineStreak.description: A failure streak (routines.streak, GLOSSARY: Failure streak).
RoutineStreak.title: RoutineStreak

RoutinesResolveMsg.description: Mark a routine's last run resolved (its judged problem is dealt with), or `undo` that.
RoutinesResolveMsg.title: RoutinesResolveMsg

RoutinesSeenMsg.description: Read a run: one routine (`id`), every run worth reading (`all`), or, with neither, whatever doesn't notify.
RoutinesSeenMsg.title: RoutinesSeenMsg

ScreenMsg.description: What the page shows now, as plain text; name None = the chat itself (nothing rides along).
ScreenMsg.title: ScreenMsg

SessionInfo.description: What agent.py keeps in FolderSession.info (from Claude Code's init message, then updated).
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

StreakRun.description: One counted run of a failure streak: its start and its checked claude.ai link.
StreakRun.title: StreakRun

TaskChangedEvent.description: A task line was rewritten (tasks.act); `previous` is what Undo puts back.
TaskChangedEvent.title: TaskChangedEvent

TaskDetailEvent.description: One task in its note (tasks.detail): the line, the note's title and heading, the lines around it.
TaskDetailEvent.title: TaskDetailEvent

TaskInfo.description: One background task (an opus-coder run or a background shell), as agent.py keeps it.
TaskInfo.title: TaskInfo

TasksBulkMsg.description:
Bulk change on tracker tasks (ids as the list shows them): `done` archives (or reopens) them, `priority` (0 to 5)
sets their priority. Exactly one of the two. The page confirms with a count first.
TasksBulkMsg.title: TasksBulkMsg

TasksSuggestMsg.description: Ask for AI-suggested priorities for the open tasks (one Haiku call, subscription only). Nothing is written to the tracker.
TasksSuggestMsg.title: TasksSuggestMsg

UsageWindow.description: One plan window from the SDK's rate-limit info (unifiedWindows).
UsageWindow.title: UsageWindow

VaultInfo.description: The notes folder as the setup shows it: where, and what Orb found in it.
VaultInfo.title: VaultInfo
